text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days after her friend's outburst
in the
shopping district, Haru Urara's
peppy self is still
nowhere in sight...
Instead, a gloomy cloud seems
to follow
her wherever she goes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until one day, I spot Urara while walking
by the
river.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Sigh... The sunset is so pretty today...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara is staring absentmindedly at
the
sunset. Like I thought, she seems a
bit down in
the dumps. I start to think of
what to say to her,
when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, Rice? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I, uh, well... Um, I've actually been
following you
from behind for a while...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, really? I didn't even notice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! You just looked so sad...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I'd probably be of no help, but... Do
you wanna
talk?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I didn't really get it, so I didn't
say
anything.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What does it mean to take running
seriously?
Can't I just have fun?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I get that I have to do something
different, but I
just don't know what!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Every time I think about what I should
do, my
head feels like it's gonna
explode! Like BOOM!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well, how about we just stay calm for
a
minute...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I know it's not the same thing, but
I've had
people get angry at me before.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I won in a race that someone else cared
really
deeply about.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I heard her sigh in disappointment.
There was so
much sadness in it... A lot
of people were really
upset about the
results.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Rice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...But I worked hard.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though all of their disappointment
could've
really discouraged me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I kept running and kept winning. And
before I
knew it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: More people started to congratulate me.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Then that means I just need to keep
trying?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: If I do that, will people stop being sad?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
My friend said she didn't want to
compete with
me... But if I keep going,
will she change her
mind?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Urara, you said you wanted to win
before,
right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wanna win! You can't win if you don't
compete,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I want everyone to see me finally win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If you still feel that way then you're fine
just as
you are.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep that dream close to
your
heart, everything will turn out just
fine.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? But that sounds hard!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I don't think I'll come up
with a
better idea even if I try for a
billion years, so I'll
just trust you, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... If anyone can do it, you
can, Urara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After talking with Rice Shower, Haru
Urara seems
to go back to her normal
self.
